_comment: Canonical Chinese renderings. Add a term here the moment you settle on a wording, so the choice sticks. banned is matched as a plain substring against the text this patch ships: data/tl_trans.json for a tl-blocks patch, the .rpy files themselves for a script-override one. A variant that is also an ordinary Chinese word, or a fragment of another name, cannot be banned -- pin it with a note here instead.
_kept_verbatim_note: These 7 entries in data/tl_trans.json have a value identical to their key on purpose, and tools/check.py --game sinfulsummer-chapter36 reads this list so they are not reported as untranslated. They are the platform names inside the Discord / SubscribeStar / Unifans promo line, the Ctrl / Tab legend, and the three bare key-cap labels on the key-binding help screen -- H hides the user interface, S takes a screenshot, V toggles self-voicing. Their descriptions, on the very next line of the patch, are translated. (< and > are not listed: they are Ren'Py conventions that tools/check.py exempts for every game.)
